title: A1.1 — Greetings & Basics
description: Master the fundamentals: greetings, numbers, family, daily routines, and essential phrases for everyday interactions.

themes.title: Greetings & Introductions
themes.description: Learn how to greet people, introduce yourself, and handle basic social interactions.

themes.title: Numbers & Colors
themes.description: Count from 0 to 100, learn colors, and describe objects.

themes.title: Family & People
themes.description: Talk about your family members, describe people, and use possessive adjectives.

themes.title: Daily Routines
themes.description: Describe your daily schedule, learn reflexive verbs, and tell time.

themes.title: Coffee Shop & Ordering
themes.description: Order food and drinks, ask for the bill, and learn numbers in context.

themes.title: City & Directions
themes.description: Navigate a city, ask for directions, and describe places.

themes.title: Tourist Essentials
themes.description: Book hotels, ask for help, and handle common tourist situations.

themes.title: Work & Introductions
themes.description: Talk about your job, workplace, and professional background.
